# tracker

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/tracker"
```

Package tracker keeps one GitHub issue per test file \(Sync\) and posts each run's results to it \(Report\).

<a name="API"></a>
## type API

API is the part of the GitHub client the tracker uses.

```go
type API interface {
    ListIssues(ctx context.Context, label string) ([]github.Issue, error)
    CreateIssue(ctx context.Context, title, body string, labels []string) (github.Issue, error)
    Comment(ctx context.Context, number int, body string) error
    EnsureLabel(ctx context.Context, name, color, description string) error
    FindProject(ctx context.Context, org string, number int) (github.Project, error)
    AddToProject(ctx context.Context, p github.Project, issueNodeID, status string) error
}
```

<a name="RunInfo"></a>
## type RunInfo

RunInfo describes the workflow run whose results are reported.

```go
type RunInfo struct {
    // URL links to the run.
    URL string
    // Name labels the link, e.g. "Suite Tests #42".
    Name string
    // SHA is the tested commit.
    SHA string
    // Ref is the tested branch or pull request, e.g. "PR #53".
    Ref string
}
```

<a name="SyncOptions"></a>
## type SyncOptions

SyncOptions control Sync.

```go
type SyncOptions struct {
    Files []discover.File
    // Project, if set, receives every issue Sync creates.
    Project *ProjectRef
    // Source is shown in new issues as where they were opened from (e.g. a
    // pull request URL).
    Source string
    DryRun bool
}
```

<a name="SyncResult"></a>
## type SyncResult

SyncResult is what Sync found and did.

```go
type SyncResult struct {
    Existing []Tracked
    Created  []Tracked
    // Warnings are failures that do not stop the sync (project updates).
    Warnings []string
}
```

<a name="Sync"></a>
### func Sync

```go
func Sync(ctx context.Context, api API, opts SyncOptions) (SyncResult, error)
```

Sync opens an issue for every test file that has none. Existing issues, open or closed, are left as they are, so a closed issue is never duplicated.

<a name="Tracked"></a>
## type Tracked

Tracked is a test file and its issue. Issue.Number is 0 for an issue a dry run would create.

```go
type Tracked struct {
    File  discover.File
    Issue github.Issue
}
```
